fusions.name: Carrion Scent
fusions.desc: Follows the scent of a wound with a spore that deals 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lunge from Murk
fusions.desc: You lunge at the target and bite for 15 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge Cycle
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Fed by Feeding
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
